title: Eleven Fires
text: The children at the stones are learning the star-song. It's a counting song. The Marro beats the count on a hoop of chimes, and the children shout the numbers.

lines.text: "The white-hair star comes. Then the fire. The white-hair star comes. Then the fire."
"Eleven times. Eleven fires. We sing them all, so we don't lose one."
"The star has a long road. It is coming back. You can see it from the high stones before dawn, if you know where to look."

choices.label: Ask what comes after the eleventh
choices.reply: "The twelfth," says the Marro, and sings no more that night.

choices.label: Look for the star
choices.reply: Before dawn the drones find it: a smudge with a pale tail, low in the east. The archive calls it Varro, and has it coming closer.
